card.title: IPhone XS Bootlooping, Fails Update with Error 4013

source.title: IPhone XS Bootlooping, Fails Update with Error 4013

claims.statement: iPhone XS / XS Max 4013 bootloops: usually the earpiece flex (liquid on flood illuminator/ALS); otherwise liquid corrosion under the interposer on the bottom board (reflow or bottom board swap).

procedure: Unplug all flexes; test known-good parts.
Repair earpiece flex keeping Face ID parts.
Split and test with known-good bottom board; reflow corrosion or swap.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
